title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Kentucky Nut 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Kentucky Nut Tobacco is a rich and earthy blend that brings together the deep, smoky character of Kentucky Tobacco with the earthy sweetness of roasted Nuts. The bold, full-bodied tobacco flavour is complemented by a nutty warmth, creating a smooth and well-rounded vape with a subtly sweet finish. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Kentucky Nut Tobacco is designed to replicate the authentic, complex flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a lasting depth of flavour while delivering a consistently satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid offers an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making it best suited for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
